units.source_text: 但是自从毕业之后，事情就变得没那么简单了，

en.t: But after she graduated, things were no longer so simple,

units.source_text: 母亲多年守寡，一个人抚养自己和妹妹，

en.t: her mother had been widowed for many years and had raised Nobuko and her younger sister alone,

units.source_text: 如今妹妹还在女子学校读书，想到这些，

en.t: and her younger sister was still studying at a girls' school; thinking of all this,

units.source_text: 信子便没办法任性的坚持自己的心意。

en.t: Nobuko could not selfishly insist on following her own wishes.

units.source_text: 因此，在她开始写作之路之前，

en.t: Therefore, before she could set out on the path of writing,

units.source_text: 不得不先考虑俗世中必须考虑的婚姻大事。

en.t: she first had to think about the serious matter of marriage, something worldly life required her to consider.
